rule: Run indoors when temperature + dew point > 150 F
summary: Temp + dew point is a runner's rule of thumb, not WBGT; performance slows steadily with WBGT and ACSM uses WBGT for heat-illness risk. Keep as a heuristic; revisit if a WBGT source is added.

sources.note: Ely 2007: marathon times slow progressively as WBGT rises 5-25 C, more so for slower runners
ACSM 2007 heat-illness stand (replaced 2023): environmental monitoring (WBGT) guides activity
